newsitem.title: UK: Israeli shares remain a buy-Merrill Lynch.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shares remain a buy-Merrill Lynch.

text.p: Market fundamentals in Israel remain strong and the recent weakness in the stockmarket should be seen as a chance to buy, despite increasing political uncertainty and the possibility of early elections, Merrill Lynch analyst Dan Lubash said on Thursday.
"The market has been at attractive levels on the price/earning growth curve and we remain overweight on the market as the fundamentals are healthy," he said in a strategy report.
Early elections would be unlikely to change those fundamentals, he added.
A weakening currency should strengthen the all-important exporters, while growth is likely to cool down to a level of four percent, which is both sustainable and less inflationary.

Any price weakness could be viewed as an opportunity to add positions in a market that, at a price/earnings ratio of 14.5 times 1997 estimated earnings, is not expensive relative to East Europe or most other emerging markets, Lubash said.
